title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
why: Agent S4 meta-agent evolves programmatic interfaces and usage knowledge for desktop CUAs from trajectories; changes action space on OSWorld-V2.

title: CUA-Recovery: Benchmarking Error Recovery in Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
why: Benchmark of policy-induced errors in multi-application desktop workflows, evaluating whether computer-use agents detect and recover from mistakes.

title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
why: ReTrace framework injects errors and replays goal-oriented actions to evaluate model-based recovery of keyboard/mouse computer-use agents.

title: LoWAgent: A Low-Resource Multilingual Benchmark for Web Agents
why: Web agent benchmark with six localized websites in English plus Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, Amharic; evaluates multilingual web navigation.

title: CanvasObs: Structured Spatial Observation for Agent Editing on 2D Infinite Canvases
why: Structured observation layer augmenting screenshots for agents selecting and editing objects in canvas apps; changes perception/grounding.

title: ClawMMU: Protection-Coherent Virtual Memory for Stateful LLM Agents
why: Borderline: provenance labels on agent memory from fetched web pages block indirect prompt injection; defense layer for browsing agents.

title: BridgeAgent: web agent with Windows desktop access (DOM + Windows UI Automation)
why: Agent spanning browser DOM and native Windows UI Automation with deterministic routing between them; changes observation/action space.
